programme.title: Os Filhos Do Homem
programme.desc: No ano de 2027, dezoito anos após o nascimento da última criança, Theo torna-se o herói improvável da raça humana ao ser requisitado pela ex-companheira para escoltar uma jovem grávida para fora do país. Numa corrida contra o tempo, Theo irá arriscar tudo para dar à luz o milagre há muito esperado.

programme.title: Copshop Não Fazemos Prisioneiros
programme.desc: Em fuga de um assassino implacável, um astuto vigarista provoca distúrbios numa cidade pequena para ser preso e assim ficar escondido na esquadra da polícia. Só que o criminoso também acaba por ser preso numa cela próxima e a chegada de um terceiro assassino torna a situação ainda mais explosiva.

programme.title: Kickboxer - A Vingança
programme.desc: O campeão de kickboxing Eric Sloane aceita participar numa luta ilegal de Muay Thai na Tailândia mas morre às mãos do implacável Tong Po. Kurt, o seu irmão mais novo, jura vingá-lo e é treinado por Durand para conseguir sobreviver à batalha final contra o mortífero lutador.

programme.title: Domino - A Hora Da Vingança
programme.desc: Um polícia de Copenhaga procura fazer justiça pela morte de um colega que foi assassinado por um homem misterioso.

programme.title: Diabolik
programme.desc: A história sombria e romântica do primeiro encontro entre o mestre ladrão Diabolik e a sedutora Eva Kant, no final da década de 1960, com o inspetor Ginko determinado a acabar com os planos do larápio, que desta feita tenta roubar um valioso diamante.

programme.title: Triângulo Da Tristeza
programme.desc: Um casal de modelos célebres embarca num cruzeiro luxuoso, com convidados muito ricos que fazem exigências loucas aos empregados, até que o barco naufraga e os passageiros se vêem encalhados numa ilha deserta, onde a hierarquia do barco sofre uma inesperada reviravolta.

programme.title: Fora De Controlo
programme.desc: Thomas Craven é um veterano da polícia que investiga o homicídio da própria filha, na sequência do qual descobre uma conspiração empresarial e governamental de proporções inesperadas.

programme.title: A Desaparecida
programme.desc: Texas, após a Guerra Civil. Quando um ataque comanche dizima a sua família e rapta a sua jovem sobrinha, Ethan Edwards parte numa busca implacável que se arrasta por anos. Acompanhado pelo sobrinho adotivo, deixa-se consumir pelo ódio e pela obsessão de a encontrar.

programme.title: Reprisal - Contra-ataque
programme.desc: Jacob testemunha um assalto ao banco onde trabalha e decide tentar apanhar o criminoso com a ajuda de um polícia reformado. Só que o assaltante contra-ataca de forma violenta, rapta a família do bancário e está preparado para levar a situação até ao limite.

programme.title: 10 Minutos
programme.desc: Rex é um mestre do crime que contrata Frank e a sua equipa para roubarem uma joia de valor inestimável. Só que algum deles sabotou o assalto, Frank é agredido e quando volta a si percebe que a joia desapareceu e não se lembra quem o atacou… E vai fazer de tudo para descobrir.

programme.title: Kickboxer III
programme.desc: David Sloane viaja para o Rio de Janeiro para um evento de kickboxing, onde acaba por salvar dois jovens e enfrentar um traficante de esclavos.

programme.title: Eliminators: Fugir Ou Morrer
programme.desc: Um antigo agente federal tem de abandonar o programa de proteção de testemunhas quando a sua casa é invadida por engano. Quando volta a ser perseguido por um perigoso assassino, tem de fugir com a filha e garantir a sua segurança antes de ser apanhado!

programme.title: À Deriva
programme.desc: Quando Tami e Richard, um casal de ávidos velejadores, se aventuram numa viagem pelo oceano, são atingidos por um furacão devastador. Após a tempestade, ela encontra-o gravemente ferido e o barco quase destruído, e vai ter de encontrar as forças necessárias para os salvar.

programme.title: Vendeta
programme.desc: Três amigos casados reúnem-se para um encontro anual de caça numa zona de deserto mas um deles traz consigo a jovem amante e a situação fica rapidamente fora de controlo. Deixada como morta no meio de um deserto infernal, a rapariga vai vingar-se e caçá-los um a um...

programme.title: Instinto Predador
programme.desc: Um navio grego transporta animais exóticos perigosos da Amazónia, incluindo um raro jaguar branco. Nessa mesma embarcação, um assassino, que estava a ser extraditado em segredo para os EUA, consegue fugir e libertar todos os animais em cativeiro, deixando os tripulantes em perigo de vida.

programme.title: À Margem Da Lei
programme.desc: Quando um ex-detective descobre que o filho foi assassinado, ele regressa às ruas que outrora tão bem conhecia para tentar saber a verdade. Armado, perigoso e sem nada a perder, ele vai enfrentar um implacável mafioso local na busca de vingança.

programme.title: Meia-noite Em Switchgrass
programme.desc: Dois agentes do FBI a investigar uma rede de tráfico sexual cruzam-se com uma série de casos de homicídios de mulheres na Florida. Quando uma missão infiltrada dá para o torto e a própria agente é raptada, um oficial daquele estado tem poucas horas para a libertar e apanhar o brutal criminoso.

programme.title: Marighella
programme.desc: É maoísta, trotskista ou leninista?´ Carlos Marighella só tem uma resposta para esta questão: ´Sou brasileiro´. Depois do golpe de Estado que derrubou um governo legitimamente eleito em 1964 e pôs uma ditadura militar no poder, Marighella conduz um grupo de jovens à resistência armada.

programme.title: O Mauritano
programme.desc: Mohamedou Ould Slahi é detido pelo governo dos EUA logo a seguir ao 11 de Setembro, e é encarcerado em Guantánamo sem julgamento durante anos. Os seus únicos aliados são a advogada de defesa Nancy Hollander e a sua associada Teri Duncan que tentam lutar por justiça e descobrir toda a verdade.

programme.title: Rio Bravo
programme.desc: O xerife John T. Chance prende o irmão de um poderoso rancheiro por homicídio e tem de o manter na cadeia até chegar o delegado federal. Cercado pelos pistoleiros pagos para o libertar, conta apenas com um ajudante alcoólico, um jovem atirador e um velho coxo para resistir.

programme.title: O Legado
programme.desc: O patriarca de uma família rica e poderosa morre subitamente, deixando à sua filha um chocante legado secreto, que ameaça destruir a sua vida…

programme.title: Os Estagiários
programme.desc: Billy e Nick são vendedores cujas carreiras foram destruídas pela era digital. Na tentativa de provar que não estão obsoletos, conseguem um cobiçado estágio na Google, juntamente com um batalhão de pequenos génios. O problema é que eles são quase info-excluídos…

programme.title: Sombras Da Escuridão
programme.desc: Barnabas Collins é um vampiro que, após ter sido enterrado vivo por 196 anos, regressa ao mundo dos vivos e à sua casa ancestral no Maine, onde encontra os seus descendentes absolutamente disfuncionais e a necessitar da sua proteção.

programme.title: Ousadas E Golpistas
programme.desc: Um grupo de strippers de Nova Iorque droga os homens de negócios de Wall Street que visitam o clube e depois rouba-lhes dinheiro do cartão de crédito, sabendo que eles não poderão ir à polícia sem denunciar que lá estiveram. Só que a prática alastra-se e o perigo torna-se muito real.

programme.title: O Chacal
programme.desc: Quando um impiedoso assassino conhecido como Chacal é contratado para eliminar um elemento importante do governo dos EUA, o diretor-adjunto do FBI vai resgatar à prisão um atirador do IRA para juntos deterem o misterioso mercenário antes que ele consiga levar a cabo a sua mortífera missão.

programme.title: O Torneio
programme.desc: Numa cidade no norte de Inglaterra, um torneio é assistido por dezenas de homens ricos, com 30 concorrentes que estão dispostos a tudo para ganhar um prémio de 10 milhões de dólares. O objetivo é simples: matar todos os adversários e ser o último sobrevivente de todos.

programme.title: O Segredo Do Refúgio
programme.desc: Dois casais alugam um refúgio perfeito à beira-mar, mas em pouco tempo o que deveria ser um fim de semana de descanso assume contornos sinistros…

programme.title: Duchess Implacável
programme.desc: Scarlett Monaghan, mais conhecida como Duchess, entra no submundo do contrabando de diamantes, torna-se a líder implacável de um grupo de crime organizado e vai fazer tudo para vingar a morte do homem que amou.

programme.title: Hollywood Gala – Awards Night
programme.desc: The Danish National Symphony Orchestra and Concert Choir take you on a musical journey through the greatest Oscar-winning films, from timeless classics like Casablanca to monumental masterpieces like The Godfather and iconic blockbusters like Forrest Gump —epic movies with music that deserves its very own place in film history.

programme.title: Documentary: Gianandrea Noseda
programme.desc: Although the great Italian composer Giuseppe Verdi applied unsuccessfully to study at the Milan Conservatory, this renowned college of music was eventually named after him. Today, the ‘Conservatorio Giuseppe Verdi’ counts numerous successful musicians among its alumni: from Giacomo Puccini, Alfredo Catalani, Claudio Abbado, Riccardo Chailly, Luigi Einaudi and Daniele Gatti, to Gianandrea Noseda.

programme.title: Thomas - Hamlet
programme.desc: Hamlet is a grand opera in five acts by the French composer Ambroise Thomas (1811-1896), with a libretto by Michel Carré and Jules Barbier. It is based on a French adaptation by Alexandre Dumas and Paul Meurice of Shakespeare's Hamlet. Thomas’ operas Mignon (1866) and Hamlet (1868) were largely neglected during the 20th century but experienced somewhat of a revival over the last decades.

programme.title: Schumann - Faschingsschwank aus Wien, Op. 26
programme.desc: After recording all 32 Ludwig van Beethoven piano sonatas to celebrate the composer's 250th birth anniversary, celebrated Italian pianist Riccardo Schwartz decided to record solo piano works by Robert Schumann. In this performance, Schwartz performs Faschingsschwank aus Wien, Op. 26 (Carnival Scenes from Vienna).

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Mahler - Das Lied von der Erde
programme.desc: Sir Simon Rattle leads the London Symphony Orchestra in Gustav Mahler’s poignant song cycle ‘Das Lied von der Erde’ (The Song of the Earth). Joining him are two of today's leading vocalists: mezzo-soprano Magdalena Kožená and tenor Andrew Staples. Written in the final years of his life, Mahler’s masterpiece contemplates the beauty of life and the sorrow of parting through some of his most personal and beautiful symphonic writing.

programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 8 in F major, Op. 93
programme.desc: Swiss conductor Philippe Jordan and the Orchestre de l’Opéra national de Paris recorded all of Ludwig van Beethoven’s symphonies in 2014-2015. In this program, Jordan conducts Beethoven’s Symphony No. 8 in F major, Op. 93. Beethoven wrote the work in 1812 upon completion of his Symphony No. 7. The composer conducted the February 27, 1814 première at a concert in Vienna that also included a reprise performance of his Symphony No.

programme.title: Beethoven Violin Concerto And Bizet Symphony in C
programme.desc: Young Venezuelan conductor Glass Marcano is a rising star. Having played in various local youth and symphony orchestras as a violinist, her first experience conducting an ensemble followed in 2012. In September 2020, she won the Orchestra Prize at La Maestra Competition – the first orchestra direction contest for women – held in Paris.

programme.title: CMIM Piano 2024 - Semi-final I: Derek Wang
programme.desc: Pianist Derek Wang (USA, 1998) joins the CMIM ensemble, consisting of three principal strings players of the Montreal Symphony Orchestra, in a performance of the first movement, Allegro, of Johannes Brahms’s Piano Quartet No 1. in G minor, Op. 25. This performance took place during the chamber music round of the two-part semi-final of the Piano Edition of the Concours musical international de Montréal 2024 (CMIM).

programme.title: Modena - City of Belcanto
programme.desc: This documentary by Mark Perna shows the training and professional growth actions for opera singers, the promotion and enhancement of the cultural offer of the city and province of Modena and the maintenance and development of the Modenese musical tradition in the field of opera.

programme.title: Berg - Piano Sonata, Op. 1
programme.desc: Italian pianist Andrea Molteni (1998) performs Alban Berg’s Piano Sonata in B minor, Op. 1. Molteni began studying the piano at the age of six. He graduated with honors and honorable mention at the Conservatorio di musica Giuseppe Verdi di Como, and was awarded a master’s degree Magna cum Laude in Advanced Performance Studies by the Conservatorio della Svizzera Italiana in Lugano.

programme.title: Arvo Pärt - Kanon Pokajanen
programme.desc: Arvo Pärt based his ‘Kanon Pokajanen’ (from ‘Canon of Repentance to Our Lord Jesus Christ’, 1995-97) on the canon of repentance as handed down in the earliest Slavic-Christian manuscripts, dating back to the sixth century after Christ. The canon symbolizes the change, the transformation from day to night, the Old and New Testament, prophecy and the fulfillment, the here and now and the hereafter.

programme.title: In Rehearsal: Zubin Mehta
programme.desc: Indian conductor Zubin Mehta (1936) became Music Director of the Israel Philharmonic Orchestra (IPO) in 1977 and was appointed Music Director for Life in 1981. On July 18, 1996, Mehta led the IPO in its first-ever performance of Richard Strauss’s tone poem Till Eulenspiegels lustige Streiche, Op. 28.

programme.title: Chopin - Piano Concerto No. 2, Op. 21
programme.desc: Antoni Wit conducts the Warsaw Philharmonic Orchestra in performance of Frédéric Chopin's Piano Concerto No. 2, Op. 21. Evgeny Kissin features as the soloist. This concert was part of the celebration of Chopin's 200th anniversary in 2010. Chopin composed the second concerto one year before the Concerto No. 1 and completed both works at the age of 20, before leaving his home country Poland and moving to Paris.

programme.title: Schumann - Davidsbündlertanze, Op. 6
programme.desc: After recording all 32 Ludwig van Beethoven piano sonatas to celebrate the composer's 250th birth anniversary, celebrated Italian pianist Riccardo Schwartz decided to record solo piano works by Robert Schumann. Davidsbündlertänze (Dances of the League of David), Op. 6, is a group of eighteen pieces for piano composed in 1837, named after Schumann's fictional music society Davidsbündler.

programme.title: Bach - Brandenburg Concerto No. 3
programme.desc: J. S. Bach’s six Brandenburg Concerto’s belong to his best-known works. The composer wrote these concertos between 1711 and 1720 and dedicated them in 1721 to Christian Ludwig, Margrave of Brandenburg. In celebration of the pieces’ 300th anniversary, Czech harpsichordist and conductor Václav Luks and the renowned Baroque ensemble Collegium 1704 recorded all six Brandenburg Concertos on historical instruments in 2021.

programme.title: Strauss' Metamorphosen And Mozart's Requiem
programme.desc: Franz Welser-Möst conducts the Cleveland Orchestra and Chorus in a concert performing Richard Strauss' Metamorphosen (A Study for 23 Solo Strings) and Mozart's Requiem, K. 626. Soloists are Siobhan Stagg (soprano), Avery Amereau (contralto), Ben Bliss (tenor) and Anthony Robin Schneider (bass). Recorded at Severance Hall, Cleveland in March 2023.

programme.title: Orff - Carmina Burana
programme.desc: Rodolfo Barráez conducts the Orchestra and Choir of the Academia de Musica del Palacia de Mineria in a performance of Carl Orff's cantata Carmina Burana. Soloists are Anabel de la Mora (soprano), Andrés Carrillo (tenor) and Daniel Cerón (baritone). Carmina Burana, composed in 1935 and 1936, is based on 24 poems from a medieval manuscript of the same name.

programme.title: Mahler - The Youth Wunderhorn
programme.desc: The Youth Wunderhorn songs are a set of 12 orchestral lieder by Mahler, based on folk poems from the collection by Arnim and Brentano, blending romanticism with folk elements and exploring human experience with authenticity and profound emotional depth. The songs draw from German folk traditions, incorporating themes of nature, love, and soldier life, often with a dramatic or poignant quality.

programme.title: Schubert - Four Impromptus, Op. 90
programme.desc: Roberto Prosseda (1975) performs Mozart's Piano Sonata No. 5 (KV. 283) and four Impromptus Op. 90 by Franz Schubert. The performance ends with Chopin's technically demanding Ballade No. 4, Op. 52. Prosseda is particularly noted for his performances of newly discovered works by Mendelssohn and has recorded a nine-CD series for Decca of the piano works of Mendelssohn.

programme.title: Danielpour - Elegies
programme.desc: Richard Danielpour (*1956) is one of the most beloved American composers of his generation due to his frequent referencing of and connection with the past, being inspired by American icons such as Aaron Copland, Samuel Barber and Leonard Bernstein. His lush musical language is often infused with swingy jazz rhythms just as is the music of Copland and Bernstein.

programme.title: Misha Fomin at the Concertgebouw
programme.desc: Since his spectacular debut recital at the Amsterdam Concertgebouw in 2002, pianist Misha Fomin has become an indispensable part of Dutch musical life. National and international press praise his playing for its fluently natural virtuosity, rich color palette, and great musical intelligence.

programme.title: Welser-Möst conducts Farrenc, Ravel And Mussorgsky
programme.desc: Franz Welser-Möst conducts the Cleveland Orchestra in a program recorded at Severance Music Center in Cleveland in March 2023. On the program are Louise Farrenc's Symphony No. 3, Ravel's Piano Concerto in G (featuring Vïkingur Ólafsson as soloist) and Mussorgsky's Pictures at an Exhibition (orchestration by Ravel).

programme.title: Heyward conducts Dvorák’s Symphony No. 9
programme.desc: American conductor Jonathon Heyward makes his debut with the London Symphony Orchestra (LSO) with this performance of Antonín Dvorák’s beloved Symphony No. 9 in E minor, Op. 95, 'From the New World'. Composed during Dvorák’s stay in the United States, the work blends Bohemian warmth with the rhythms and spirit of American musical traditions.

programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 2 in D major, Op. 36
programme.desc: Swiss conductor Philippe Jordan and the Orchestre de l’Opéra national de Paris recorded all of Ludwig van Beethoven’s symphonies in 2014-2015. In this program, Jordan conducts Beethoven’s Symphony No. 2 in D major, Op. 36. Completed in 1802, the work saw its first performance at the Theater an der Wien on April 5, 1803. That same concert also included the premieres of the composer’s Piano Concerto No.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Tchaikovsky - Iolanta
programme.desc: ‘Iolanta’ and ‘Perséphone’ – A double bill consisting of two stage works that “represent an ideal of beauty, poetry and hope” forms this new production by Peter Sellars in Madrid from the Teatro Real from 2012. In both works, the progression from darkness to light acts as an initiation rite that completely transforms the existential attitude of the leading characters.

programme.title: The LSO performs Boulanger, Dalbavie And Tchaikovsky
programme.desc: Polish conductor Marta Gardolinska conducts the London Symphony Orchestra (LSO) in a concert program consisting of Lili Boulanger’s D’un Martin de Printemps, Marc-André Dalbavie’s Concerto for Flute, and Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky’s Symphony No. 4 in F minor, Op. 36. The luminous optimism of the young Boulanger is poles apart from the raw passion and white-hot melodies of Tchaikovsky’s semi-autobiographical symphony.

programme.title: Clara Haskil - Le mystère de l’interprète
programme.desc: The documentary “Clara Haskil - Le mystère de l’interprète” (2017) tells the remarkable life story of Romanian pianist Clara Haskil (1895-1960). Born in Bucharest into a Jewish family, she began her career as a child prodigy, entering the Bucharest Conservatory at a very young age. She continued her music studies in Vienna and Paris. Haskil suffered from chronic health issues and lived through two world wars, which held back her career.

programme.title: Richard Strauss - A Hero's Life, Op. 40
programme.desc: Franz Welser-Möst leads the Cleveland Orchestra in a concert performing Richard Strauss' Ein Heldenleben, Op. 40. Violin soloist is David Radzynski. Recorded at Severance Hall in Cleveland in February 2023. Strauss, at the age of 34, sparked outrage when he cast himself as the central figure of his tone poem. Generally agreed to be autobiographical, the work contains more than thirty quotations from Strauss's earlier works.

programme.title: Liszt - Due Poemi Sinfonici
programme.desc: Franz Liszt (1811 - 1886) composed 13 symphonic poems, largely inspired by literary texts. The composer himself wrote piano duet arrangements for these pieces, showcasing his incredible ability of imitating a full orchestra on the piano. Liszt, one of the 19th century’s most important piano virtuosos, strongly influenced the further development of piano music.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: IVC 2021 - Final: Schumann, Sibelius a. o.
programme.desc: Baritone Arvid Fagerfjäll (Sweden, 1991) and pianist Hikaru Kanki (Japan, 1993) perform ‘Lust der Sturmnacht’ from Robert Schumann’s Kerner-Lieder, Op. 35; ‘Le diable dans la nuit’ from Henriëtte Bosmans’ Dix mélodies; Franz Schubert’s Totengräbers Heimweh, D.

programme.title: Tchaikovsky - Overture-Fantasy Romeo and Juliet
programme.desc: Conrad van Alphen conducts Sinfonia Rotterdam in a performance of Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky’s Overture-Fantasy “Romeo and Juliet”. Van Alphen founded Sinfonia Rotterdam in 2000. Under his passionate leadership, this orchestra has developed into one of the Netherland’s best-known orchestras. Tchaikovsky based his composition on Shakespeare’s famous play “Romeo and Juliet”.

programme.title: Bach - Goldberg Variations (BWV 988)
programme.desc: Chinese pianist Zhu Xiao-Mei performs J. S. Bach's Goldberg Variations (BWV 988) at the Leipzig Bach Festival. This June 2014 concert was recorded at St. Thomas Church, where Bach spent most time of his career as 'Thomaskantor', the musical director of the Thomanerchor church choir. The Goldberg Variations consist of one aria and a set of 30 variations.

programme.title: Brahms - Clarinet Sonata No. 2, Op. 120
programme.desc: Written in 1894, the two Clarinet Sonatas, Op. 120 are the last chamber music pieces Johannes Brahms composed. In this performance at Het Groene Paviljoen in Baarn, the Netherlands, clarinetist Henk de Graaf and pianist Daniël Wayenberg play Brahms’s Clarinet Sonata No. 2 in E-flat major, Op. 120.

programme.title: Hans van Manen – Moving to Music
programme.desc: Dutch choreographer Hans van Manen (1932) is internationally recognized as one of the grand masters of contemporary ballet. His over 150 ballets all bear his distinct signature, featuring a great clarity in structure, refined simplicity and an aversion to decorative frills.

programme.title: Schumann - Fantasiestücke, Op. 12
programme.desc: After recording all 32 Ludwig van Beethoven piano sonatas to celebrate the composer's 250th birth anniversary, celebrated Italian pianist Riccardo Schwartz decided to record solo piano works by Robert Schumann. In this performance, Schwartz presents Schumann’s Fantasiestücke, Op. 12. Written in 1837, the work is a set of eight piano pieces with contrasting moods.

programme.title: In the Organ's Stomach
programme.desc: Olivier Latry is the current holder of the Great Organ of Notre Dame. Between its original religious function and the interest of composers of all times, the great organ Cavaillé-Coll reveals its absolute modernity. Latry is considered one of the greatest organists of his generation, both in France and internationally.

programme.title: Beethoven-String Quartet No. 14, Op. 131
programme.desc: Renowned French string quartet Quatuor Ébène marked the 250th birth anniversary of Ludwig van Beethoven (1770-1827) with a remarkable project: recording all of the great composer’s sixteen string quartets. For five years, violinists Pierre Colombet and Gabriel Le Magadure, violist Marie Chilemme, and cellist Raphaël Merlin immersed themselves in Beethoven’s 650 pages of sheet music.

programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 1 in C major, Op. 21
programme.desc: Swiss conductor Philippe Jordan and the Orchestre de l’Opéra national de Paris recorded all of Ludwig van Beethoven’s symphonies in 2014-2015. In this program, Jordan conducts Symphony No. 1 in C major, Op. 21. This symphony shows Beethoven’s loyalty to the model of Joseph Haydn’s and Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s late symphonies, yet reveals his attempt to distinguish himself from his predecessors.

programme.title: Piano Duets - Mozart, Ravel, Rachmaninoff a. o.
programme.desc: In this splendid concert, exceptional Russian pianists Nikolay Lugansky and Vadim Rudenko join forces in a program for two pianos comprising works of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart, Maurice Ravel, Anton Arensky, Sergei Rachmaninoff, and Nikolai Kapustin. Both pianists, laureates of the prestigious International Tchaikovsky Competition in 1994, have received international recognition. They perform regularly in a duo.

programme.title: Tchaikovsky - Piano Concerto No. 1
programme.desc: A colourful Christmas concert by the South Netherlands Philharmonic with Tchaikovsky’s famous First Piano Concerto. Chief conductor Dmitry Liss showcases, together with master pianist Boris Berezovsky, a true, Russian spirit. In such a way as to evoke what an American critic had said about one of his previous Tchaikovsky interpretations: “Liss expressed an absolute authority over the orchestra and the audience.

programme.title: Live in Aix-en-Provence
programme.desc: The shy and elusive Grigroy Sokolov is one of the greatest pianists of our time. His performances leave critics and audiences alike speechless, like they don't quite believe what they have just experienced. In 2015, he played a beautiful recital with works by Johann Sebastian Bach, Ludwig van Beethoven, Franz Schubert, Frédéric Chopin, and Claude Debussy that took place at the Festival La Roque D'Anthéron in Aix-en-Provence.

programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 8 in F major, Op. 93
programme.desc: Swiss conductor Philippe Jordan and the Orchestre de l’Opéra national de Paris recorded all of Ludwig van Beethoven’s symphonies in 2014-2015. In this program, Jordan conducts Beethoven’s Symphony No. 8 in F major, Op. 93. Beethoven wrote the work in 1812 upon completion of his Symphony No. 7. The composer conducted the February 27, 1814 première at a concert in Vienna that also included a reprise performance of his Symphony No.

programme.title: Tribute to Hans van Manen
programme.desc: Dutch choreographer Hans van Manen (1932) is internationally recognized as one of the grand masters of contemporary ballet. His over 150 ballets all bear his distinct signature, featuring a great clarity in structure, refined simplicity and an aversion to decorative frills. In this tribute to the great choreographer, dancers of the Dutch National Ballet perform three masterpieces from Van Manen’s extensive oeuvre.

programme.title: Mosaïque Project - Canadian Piano Quartets
programme.desc: This very special concert event celebrates the diversity and richness of Canada through the eyes and ears of its people. Ensemble Made in Canada’s Mosaique Project features a commissioned suite of piano quartets by 14 Canadian composers, each inspired by a region of our vast country. Their album release and two-year National tour culminate in St. Catharines’ stunning Partridge Hall!

programme.title: Works by Mozart and Sarti
programme.desc: Italian conductor Mattia Rondelli conducts the Orchestra dell’Opera Carlo Felice Genova in a concert program consisting of works by Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart and Giuseppe Sarti. Soprano Barbara Massaro is the soloist. On the program are Mozart’s Symphony No. 5 in B-flat major, K.

programme.title: Shostakovich - Concertino for two pianos
programme.desc: On the occasion of her 80th birthday, Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich explored repertoire for piano and violin in this wonderful concert, recorded at Château de Chantilly, France. The ‘Grande Dame’ of the piano is joined by various renowned artists, including pianists Evgeny Kissin, Theodosia Ntokou, and Cristina Marton-Argerich, and violinist Maxim Vengerov. On the program are Dmitri Shostakovich’s Concertino for two pianos, Op.

programme.title: Martinu° - Concertino for Piano Trio and Strings
programme.desc: The Italian-Swiss ensemble Trio des Alpes, consisting of Hana Kotková (violin), Claude Hauri (cello), and Corrado Greco (piano), and the Orchestra da Camera di Mantova join forces in this performance of the Concertino for Piano Trio and String Orchestra, H. 232 by Czech composer Bohuslav Martin (1890-1959). Martin was a prolific composer, creating an oeuvre of almost 400 works.

programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 2, Op. 36
programme.desc: In this concert at the Lucerne Festival, Swedish conductor Herbert Blomstedt leads the Lucerne Festival Orchestra in a performance of Ludwig van Beethoven's Symphony No. 2 in D major, Op. 36. This performance was recorded at the Lucerne Culture and Congress Center (KKL), Switzerland, in August 2020.

programme.title: Approaching the Maelström
programme.desc: The 2019 documentary ‘Approaching the Maelström’ follows the process leading up to a recording of American composer Philip Glass’s composition ‘A Descent into the Maelström’. The work is based on American writer Edgar Allan Poe’s 1841 short story of two fishermen caught in torrents raging between the mountainous islands of Lofoten, Norway.

programme.title: Welser-Möst conducts Farrenc, Ravel And Mussorgsky
programme.desc: Franz Welser-Möst conducts the Cleveland Orchestra in a program recorded at Severance Music Center in Cleveland in March 2023. On the program are Louise Farrenc's Symphony No. 3, Ravel's Piano Concerto in G (featuring Vïkingur Ólafsson as soloist) and Mussorgsky's Pictures at an Exhibition (orchestration by Ravel).

programme.title: Delibes - Lakmé
programme.desc: Frédéric Chaslin (1963) leads the Orchestra and Chorus of the Opéra Royal de Wallonie-Liège in a performance of Léo Delibes’s tragic opera Lakmé (1883). Written to a libretto by Edmond Gondinet and Philippe Gille, the opera is set in nineteenth-century British India and tells the story of Lakmé, who falls in love with Gérald, a British officer.

programme.title: Works by Bach, Bartók, and Brahms
programme.desc: Iván Fischer leads his Budapest Festival Orchestra in an exciting concert program consisting of works by J. S. Bach, Béla Bartók, and Johannes Brahms. The program opens with Bach’s Brandenburg Concerto No. 3 in G major, BWV 1048. This is followed by one of Bartók’s best-known pieces: Music for strings, percussion and celesta.

programme.title: In Rehearsal: Zubin Mehta
programme.desc: Indian conductor Zubin Mehta (1936) became Music Director of the Israel Philharmonic Orchestra (IPO) in 1977 and was appointed Music Director for Life in 1981. On July 18, 1996, Mehta led the IPO in its first-ever performance of Richard Strauss’s tone poem Till Eulenspiegels lustige Streiche, Op. 28.

programme.title: A História Do Universo T10 - Ep. 6
programme.desc: Pensa-se que a misteriosa matéria negra é a «cola cósmica» que mantém o universo unido, mas a sua procura continua um enigmas para os cientistas.

programme.title: A História Do Universo T10 - Ep. 7
programme.desc: Resultados contraditórios dificultam a determinação da idade do universo. Encontrar a resposta poderia ser a solução para muitos mistérios do cosmos.

programme.title: A História Do Universo T10 - Ep. 8
programme.desc: Uma equipa de robôs parte numa missão a Marte para desvendar os seus segredos. Agora, a Perseverance junta-se a eles para saber se alguma vez houve vida no planeta vermelho.

programme.title: A História Do Universo T10 - Ep. 9
programme.desc: Os especialistas descobrem a origem da energia proveniente de um buraco negro. Analisam o que acontece quando os dois objetos mais poderosos do cosmos colidem.

programme.title: A História Do Universo T10 - Ep. 10
programme.desc: Um asteroide fictício atinge a terra. Os cientistas seguem a história que se desenrola, perguntando o que acontecerá a seguir e o que será feito a respeito dela?

programme.title: A História Do Universo T5 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: O Universo é um sítio violento e perigoso. Desde estrelas a explodir e galáxias a colidir, passando por ondas de choque de nebulosas - quais são os piores locais do universo?

programme.title: O Segredo Das Coisas T25 - Ep. 11
programme.desc: Mais objetos do quotidiano são analisados ao microscópio. Como é que as luzes cerâmicas de bambu e os compactadores de asfalto são feitos?

programme.title: O Segredo Das Coisas T9 - Ep. 7
programme.desc: À medida que objetos do quotidiano são vistos à lupa, saiba como canoas, lava-louças em aço inoxidável, couro e pedal steel guitars são feitos.

programme.title: O Segredo Das Coisas T9 - Ep. 8
programme.desc: Saiba como espadas, barcos, relógios e fusíveis são feitos.

programme.title: Joias Sobre Rodas T15 - Ep. 17
programme.desc: Mike Brewer e o multifacetado mecânico Ant Anstead têm como missão encontrar e restaurar carros icónicos que mais tarde vendem na sua oficina de Los Angeles.

programme.title: Joias Sobre Rodas T15 - Ep. 18
programme.desc: Mike Brewer e o multifacetado mecânico Ant Anstead têm como missão encontrar e restaurar carros icónicos que mais tarde vendem na sua oficina de Los Angeles.

programme.title: Joias Sobre Rodas T9 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Mike viaja até Trieste para comprar um carro desportivo dos anos 70. O veículo precisa de arranjos antes de Mike e Eddie tentarem encontrar um comprador.

programme.title: Na Rota Do Ouro Com Parker Schnabel T6 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Parker descobre as ricas terras de Madre de Dios. A equipa entra na selva com uma tribo local para procurar terreno inexplorado.

programme.title: Alasca, A Última Fronteira T7 - Ep. 7
programme.desc: Sempre levados ao limite pelos elementos, circunstâncias e uns pelos outros, os Kilcher continuam a trabalhar juntos em família para manter o valioso património das suas terras.

programme.title: Alasca, A Última Fronteira T7 - Ep. 8
programme.desc: Sempre levados ao limite pelos elementos, circunstâncias e uns pelos outros, os Kilcher continuam a trabalhar juntos em família para manter o valioso património das suas terras.

programme.title: A Febre Do Ouro T11 - Ep. 15
programme.desc: Os mineiros do ouro de Yukon arriscam tudo na esperança de enriquecerem da noite para o dia. Com mineiros, reivindicações e máquinas novas, os riscos nunca foram tão grandes!

programme.title: A Febre Do Ouro T11 - Ep. 16
programme.desc: Os mineiros do ouro de Yukon arriscam tudo na esperança de enriquecerem da noite para o dia. Com mineiros, reivindicações e máquinas novas, os riscos nunca foram tão grandes!

programme.title: A Febre Do Ouro T11 - Ep. 17
programme.desc: Os mineiros do ouro de Yukon arriscam tudo na esperança de enriquecerem da noite para o dia. Com mineiros, reivindicações e máquinas novas, os riscos nunca foram tão grandes!

programme.title: A Febre Do Ouro T11 - Ep. 18
programme.desc: Os mineiros do ouro de Yukon arriscam tudo na esperança de enriquecerem da noite para o dia. Com mineiros, reivindicações e máquinas novas, os riscos nunca foram tão grandes!

programme.title: O Segredo Das Coisas T9 - Ep. 9
programme.desc: Pára-choques, bengalas doces, gel luminoso, filtros fotográficos e modelos a vapor estão entre os objetos do dia-a-dia que são vistos ao microscópio.

programme.title: O Segredo Das Coisas T9 - Ep. 10
programme.desc: Saiba como objetos do dia-a-dia tais como chapéus de chuva, talheres de prata, fitas métricas e motores externos são feitos.

programme.title: O Segredo Das Coisas T9 - Ep. 11
programme.desc: Bisturis, tintas de óleo, capacetes da polícia britânica e machados de alpinismo são alguns dos objetos do quotidiano analisados neste episódio.

programme.title: O Segredo Das Coisas T9 - Ep. 12
programme.desc: Descubra como coisas como bacon, máquinas de neve e carros de luxo são feitos.

programme.title: O Segredo Das Coisas T9 - Ep. 13
programme.desc: À medida que objetos do quotidiano são vistos à lupa, saiba como transmissões, pratas em miniatura, cestos de balões de ar quente e os dardos são feitos.

programme.title: O Segredo Das Coisas T26 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: Mais objetos do quotidiano são vistos ao microscópio, revelando a sua produção. Como são feitos objetos como aspiradores de folhas e resíduos, carne enlatada e facas?

programme.title: O Segredo Das Coisas T10 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Mais objetos do dia-a-dia são vistos ao microscópio enquanto descobrimos como são feitos, incluindo ímanes, fiambre e bules prateados.

programme.title: O Segredo Das Coisas T10 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Mais objetos do dia-a-dia são vistos ao microscópio enquanto descobrimos como são feitos, incluindo pedras de curling, frigoríficos, tacos de basebol e vidro opalescente.

programme.title: O Segredo Das Coisas T10 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Mais objetos do dia-a-dia são vistos ao microscópio enquanto descobrimos como são feitos, incluindo níveis, cachorros quentes, grãos abrasivos e lixa.

programme.title: O Segredo Das Coisas T25 - Ep. 12
programme.desc: Mais objetos do quotidiano são analisados ao microscópio. Como é que são feitos o tradicional fiambre basco e as cartolas?

programme.title: Mestres Do Restauro T6 - Ep. 6
programme.desc: Júlia restaura uma cabeça de pavão partida de um carro alegórico para Natasha. Steve resgata duas mesas antigas de uma casa senhorial em Suffolk.

programme.title: Mestres Do Restauro T6 - Ep. 7
programme.desc: Os especialistas em autómatos Michael e Maria restauram um raro porco mecânico para Drew. A tecelã convidada Cherry resgata uma poltrona dinamarquesa.

programme.title: Mestres Do Restauro T6 - Ep. 8
programme.desc: O restaurador de mobília Steve Norman resgata uma secretária de campanha militar. Ted Edley transforma um carro a pedais os anos 60 num de corrida.

programme.title: Maine Cabin Masters T13 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: A equipa regressa ao seu antigo liceu para construir uma sala de aula ao ar livre. Destina-se a ser um bom espaço de aprendizagem com muita arrumação.

programme.title: Maine Cabin Masters T13 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: A equipa ocupa-se da cabana escura e húmida com uma disposição antiquada e muito caruncho. É uma enorme revisão com martelos, serras e lixas.

programme.title: O Lado Escuro Do Sol
programme.desc: Os cientistas só recentemente começaram a entender a verdadeira natureza da «estrela local»: o Sol. Este programa debate o seu passado e futuro, e o seu efeito sobre nosso planeta.

programme.title: Aurora T1 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Após os primeiros passos do homem na Lua há mais de 50 anos, o espaço continua a inspirar. Explorar o sistema solar nunca foi tão ilimitado.

programme.title: A História Do Universo T10 - Ep. 7
programme.desc: Resultados contraditórios dificultam a determinação da idade do universo. Encontrar a resposta poderia ser a solução para muitos mistérios do cosmos.

programme.title: A História Do Universo T10 - Ep. 11
programme.desc: Novas descobertas reescreveram a história do nosso sistema solar. Revelam uma história complexa e violenta, desde o nascimento do sol até ao seu destino final.

programme.title: A História Do Universo T8 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Júpiter. O Rei dos Planetas. Juno, a sonda da NASA, está a revelar os segredos de Júpiter, respondendo a mistérios sobre o planeta, a Terra e a própria vida.

programme.title: A História Do Universo T8 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: As missões tripuladas a Marte são a próxima fronteira da exploração humana e a NASA quer pisar o Planeta Vermelho em 2035. Mas será esta uma missão impossível?

programme.title: A História Do Universo T8 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Alguns dos teóricos e das mentes mais brilhantes do planeta explorem os limites do conhecimento humano e explicam a ciência por detrás das regras do universo.

programme.title: A História Do Universo T5 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Os gigantescos buracos negros são tão grandes que devoram estrelas e dão forma a galáxias. A mais recente ciência pode responder ao porquê de crescerem tanto.

programme.title: O Segredo Das Coisas T25 - Ep. 13
programme.desc: Mais objetos do quotidiano são analisados ao microscópio. Como é que os pavimentadores de alcatrão e os sapatos bascos são feitos?

programme.title: O Segredo Das Coisas T10 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Mais objetos do dia-a-dia são vistos ao microscópio enquanto descobrimos como são feitos, incluindo gelados, tacos de golfe, asas de aviões e reciclagem de baterias de automóveis.

programme.title: O Segredo Das Coisas T10 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: Mais objetos do dia-a-dia são vistos ao microscópio enquanto descobrimos como são feitos, incluindo bombas de combustível, bastões de críquete e tubo de ferro dúctil.

programme.title: Joias Sobre Rodas T15 - Ep. 22
programme.desc: Mike localiza um Chevy C10 de '71. Está em excelentes condições, mas ele sente que poderiam maximizar o seu lucro se o tornassem mais 'conduzível'.

programme.title: Joias Sobre Rodas T15 - Ep. 11
programme.desc: Mike encontra um Fiat 124 Spider de 1972 que precisa de uma melhoria na sua condução. Mike deita as mãos ao trabalho no interior, enquanto Ant arranja o diferencial.

programme.title: Na Rota Do Ouro Com Parker Schnabel T6 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Parker sonda a montanha La Rinconada, a mina de ouro mais alta do mundo. Parker faz uma grande descoberta, mas uma doença súbita ameaça acabar com a viagem mais cedo.

programme.title: Na Rota Do Ouro Com Parker Schnabel T6 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Parker segue o ouro até à Bolívia, onde espera entrar na indústria do ouro, que vale 2,5 mil milhões de $. A equipa obtém uma pista de uma operação de extração de ouro de aluvião.

programme.desc: Sempre levados ao limite pelos elementos, circunstâncias e uns pelos outros, os Kilcher continuam a trabalhar juntos em família para manter o valioso património das suas terras.

programme.desc: Kafkas, um jovem pugilista promissor, tem sua vida virada de cabeça para baixo com um infeliz incidente que o força a abandonar a carreira e se despedir dos ringues. Anos depois, ele retornará ao ringue por seu filho Günes e ficará por mais um assalto.

programme.title: Segure Minha Mão T1 - Ep. 90
programme.desc: A história gira em torno de uma garota chamada Azra, que está estudando no exterior, na América, para se tornar cozinheira profissional, assim como seu pai.

programme.title: Ressurreição: Ertugru T2 - Ep. 96
programme.desc: Na segunda temporada, a tribo Kayi alia-se aos clãs turcomanos para resistir à invasão mongol. Ertugrul é capturado e torturado, mas escapa e regressa para enfrentar a traição, o exílio e planos maquiavélicos. Expõe conspirações, resgata o seu filho, derrota Noyan e leva o seu povo para oeste para fundar um novo estado.

programme.title: O Jogo do Destino - Ep. 20
programme.desc: Bahar abre um curso profissional num bairro pobre para ajudar as donas de casa, e aí conhece Demir. O conflito entre ambos começa com uma confusão ao comprar uma sobremesa e num acidente de mota. Apesar da tensão, forma-se um laço. Quando Bahar fica presa num incêndio, Demir arrisca a própria vida para a salvar. Entretanto, Aysun planeia vingar-se de Harun, planeando casar com ele, matá-lo e começar uma nova vida com Demir.

programme.title: Nova Oportunidade T1 - Ep. 78
programme.desc: NOVA OPORTUNIDADE é uma nova série dramática ambiciosa e de grande sucesso, com algumas das maiores estrelas da Turquia. A história centra-se em Deniz, uma mulher inocente que tem tudo o que poderia desejar na vida, até que o marido desaparece sem deixar rasto. Após perder tudo o que possuía, vê-se numa situação desesperada e enfrenta uma luta diária pela sobrevivência, necessitando de lutar pelo bem dos seus filhos e do seu pai idoso.

programme.title: O Círculo - Ep. 39
programme.desc: Dois jovens, Cihangir e Kaan, são atraídos para um jogo mortal gerido por uma organização criminosa chamada O Círculo. Trocados à nascença por líderes da máfia, crescem sem conhecer as suas verdadeiras identidades. Anos mais tarde, os seus caminhos voltam a cruzar-se enquanto lutam pela justiça e pelo amor, enredados numa teia de segredos, traição e poder.

Quando Bahar fica presa num incêndio, Demir arrisca a própria vida para a salvar. Entretanto, Aysun planeia vingar-se de Harun, planeando casar com ele, matá-lo e começar uma nova vida com Demir.

programme.title: Meu Campeão - Ep. 40
programme.desc: Kafkas, um jovem pugilista promissor, tem sua vida virada de cabeça para baixo com um infeliz incidente que o força a abandonar a carreira e se despedir dos ringues. Anos depois, ele retornará ao ringue por seu filho Günes e ficará por mais um assalto.

programme.title: Nova Oportunidade T1 - Ep. 79
programme.desc: NOVA OPORTUNIDADE é uma nova série dramática ambiciosa e de grande sucesso, com algumas das maiores estrelas da Turquia. A história centra-se em Deniz, uma mulher inocente que tem tudo o que poderia desejar na vida, até que o marido desaparece sem deixar rasto. Após perder tudo o que possuía, vê-se numa situação desesperada e enfrenta uma luta diária pela sobrevivência, necessitando de lutar pelo bem dos seus filhos e do seu pai idoso.

programme.title: O Círculo - Ep. 40
programme.desc: Dois jovens, Cihangir e Kaan, são atraídos para um jogo mortal gerido por uma organização criminosa chamada O Círculo. Trocados à nascença por líderes da máfia, crescem sem conhecer as suas verdadeiras identidades. Anos mais tarde, os seus caminhos voltam a cruzar-se enquanto lutam pela justiça e pelo amor, enredados numa teia de segredos, traição e poder.

programme.title: Patáx: A Night to Remember 1/2
programme.desc: Patáx was heavily influenced by seminal fusion bands like Weather Report and Return to Forever. Don’t mistake this Spanish powerhouse for a carbon copy of either, however, as Patáx presents an accomplished mix of styles, including soul, jazz, funk and hip-hop. The group is led by the passionate Spanish-American percussionist Jorge Perez, who draws his musical influence from both sides of the Atlantic.

programme.title: Jazz à Vienne
programme.desc: World-renowned American blues singer and guitarist Magic Slim performed an electrifying set at the French festival Jazz à Vienne 2012. With bandmates John McDonald (guitar And vocals), Andre Howard (bass), and Brian Jones (drums), the blues giant played a string of classic Chicago blues hits. Ever energetic, the veritable blues veteran put on a dynamic show for an enthusiastic audience in the atmospheric ancient Roman theatre of Vienne.

programme.title: Morgenland: Songs Without Frontiers
programme.desc: Since 2005, the Morgenland Festival of Osnabrueck has dedicated itself to the fascinating music culture of the Near and Middle East. From traditional and classical music to avant-garde, jazz, and rock, the festival program also features art, such as visual arts, dance, and theatre of interdisciplinary projects.

programme.title: Lucky Chops - Live at BIRD
programme.desc: The NYC band Lucky Chops rose to fame when a video of their performance at a subway station went viral on YouTube in 2015. Since then, the energetic quintet has been entertaining audiences all over the world. The band was formed in 2006, when trumpeter Joshua Gawel, saxophonist Daro Behroozi, trombonist Josh Holcomb, tubist Raphael Buyo, and drummer Charles Sams, met during their education at Fiorello H.

programme.title: Invisible World - WOMEX 2018
programme.desc: Since 1994, World Music Expo (WOMEX) has been attracting musicians, agents, a great number of press agencies, as well as media companies from all over the world. Its main exposition event has been held in various locations throughout Europe, including Berlin, Brussels, Marseille, Stockholm, Seville, Cardiff, and Budapest. In 2018, WOMEX was held in Las Palmas, Gran Canaria.

programme.title: Buck Clayton - Radio Télévision Suisse 'Variétés'
programme.desc: In the second half of June 1965, during a prolonged European concert tour, American trumpeter Buck Clayton (1911–1991) played a residency at the Chikito, a club in Bern, Switzerland.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: That Old Feeling
programme.desc: The legendary hard-bop group Art Blakey's Jazz Messengers performed in Olympia Hall in Paris, France on March 16, 1963. Led by drummer Art Blakey, the Jazz Messengers consisted of Wayne Shorter on tenor saxophone, Freddie Hubbard on trumpet, Curtis Fuller on trombone, Reggie Workman on double bass, and Cedar Walton on piano. Each of these players became jazz legends in their own right.

programme.title: Duke Ellington Orchestra - Het Concertgebouw
programme.desc: The Royal Concertgebouw in Amsterdam is a world-renowned concert hall, known for its first-rate acoustics. It has attracted many famous performers over the years and is one of the Netherlands' most treasured musical institutions. On November 2, 1958, American jazz titan Duke Ellington and his Orchestra performed two concerts at the Concertgebouw in Amsterdam.

programme.title: Melody Gardot at Château d'Hérouville
programme.desc: In the 1960s, composer Michel Magne transformed the Château d'Hérouville, an 18th-century country house north of Paris and former home of lovers George Sand and Frédéric Chopin, into the first residential recording studio. In addition to its excellent facilities, the complex featured a swimming pool and a beautiful garden, allowing artists to stay for weeks or months at a time.

programme.title: Belgium Sessions: Hijaz
programme.desc: In this DJAZZ Belgium Sessions performance, which was recorded at AED Studios in Lint, Belgium, we witness Europe’s finest jazz musicians at work. A wide variety of international jazz musicians give a creative, up-close and inside insight into their art of playing jazz music. Young talent and established jazz musicians play to their heart’s content: take for instance this unusual performance by the multi-ethnic ensemble Hijaz.

programme.title: Thelonious Monk - Well You Needn't
programme.desc: Pianist Kenny Barron’s June 27, 2019 appearance at the Alfa Jazz Festival in Ukraine’s Lviv was a celebration of sublime jazz virtuosity. The revered elder statesmen of jazz piano brought his regular working trio of Kiyoshi Kitagawa (bass) and Jonathan Blake (drums), augmented by stellar jazzman Marcus Strickland (tenor saxophone) and young lion Riley Mulherkar (trumpet).

programme.title: DJAZZ Portrait: Eli Paperboy Reed
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts.

programme.title: Chet Baker - Time after time
programme.desc: This selection of unforgettable performances by some of the most iconic and influential male jazz and pop vocalists in history showcases these legends’ unique essence. Delight in the expressive beauty and emotional depth of Chet Baker's rendition of “Time After Time” and “You Don't Know What Love Is', recorded live in Brussels, Belgium in 1964 and in Rome, Italy in 1956 respectively.

programme.title: Herbie Mann - Münchner Klaviersommer
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. The concerts were usually held in July at The Gasteig, home of the Munich Philharmonic.

programme.title: Michelle David - Jazz in Duketown
programme.desc: Jazz in Duketown is the largest free outdoor jazz festival in the Netherlands. It's a real gathering for jazz addicts, inviting internationally renowned artists. The talented American singer Michelle David performs pop and gospel music that feeds the heart and soothes the soul. Having grown up with the church, she started singing at the age of four. A year later she joined her first band, The Mission of Love.

programme.title: Horace Silver - Song for my father
programme.desc: Embark on a remarkable journey through the world of jazz piano as we showcase some of the most iconic and influential pianists in history. This collection of extraordinary performances captures the unique essence and brilliance of legendary pianists Art Tatum, Thelonious Monk, Bud Powell, and others. Revel in Oscar Peterson’s virtuosity as his trio plays “C-Jam Blues” in Holbaek, Denmark, on May 2, 1964.

programme.title: Mike Stern And Didier Lockwood: Jazz à Vienne
programme.desc: Guitarist Mike Stern and violin player Didier Lockwood sharing a stage: that promises a good show! After playing for years with Blood, Sweat And Tears, Mike Stern landed a gig with drummer Billy Cobham and then broke through with Miles Davis’ comeback band in the 1980s. Didier Lockwood played in jazz fusion band Magma during the 1970s and is known for his use of electric amplification and experimentation.

programme.title: BIRDtv: Hypnotic Brass Ensemble
programme.desc: Rotterdam’s BIRD is a club, café, and restaurant with a live music program that's deeply rooted in jazz, soul, funk, hip-hop, and electronic. Its name BIRD refers to the nickname of legendary New York jazz saxophonist, bebop co-founder Charlie Parker. BIRD serves Neapolitan pizzas, fine wines, no-nonsense beers, and an all-round metropolitan rawness. Since 2014, this urban jazz club and DJAZZ.

programme.title: China Moses: 'Whatever' at Jazz à Ramatuelle
programme.desc: In 1988, Dee Dee Bridgewater was one of the first great jazz singers to perform at the Jazz Festival in Ramatuelle. In 2016, the story seems to repeat itself as her daughter China Moses took the stage at Ramatuelle. Over the years, China Moses has become a mature performer with a unique style: rocky voice, sharp sense of swing, and intense/energetic stage presence.

programme.title: 29th Street Saxophone Quartet: Estival 1987
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence.

programme.title: jazzahead! 2023
programme.desc: Annual trade fair, exhibition, and festival jazzahead! is one of the international jazz community's most important events. Hosted in Bremen, Germany, jazzahead! brings together musicians, bookers, agents, organizers, jazz experts, and music enthusiasts at the world’s largest jazz event. In 2023, jazzahead!

programme.title: Malta Jazz Festival
programme.desc: The vibrant island of Malta was in for a night of light and cheerful music when Brazilian music legend João Bosco took the stage on July 21, 2018. The self-taught guitarist made his music debut in the 1970s alongside Elis Regina and Aldir Blanc.

programme.title: Count Basie and his Orchestra live in Charleroi
programme.desc: Count Basie is one of the most important bandleaders of the swing era. With the exception of a brief period in the early '50s, he led a big band from 1935 until his death almost 50 years later. Basie's orchestra was characterized by a light, swinging rhythm section that he led from the piano, lively ensemble work, and generous soloing. Basie was not a composer like Duke Ellington or an important soloist like Benny Goodman.

programme.title: Spyro Gyra - North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. In 1982, the American jazz fusion band Spyro Gyra took the stage at the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague.

programme.title: Mezzoforte - North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. In 1986, famed Icelandic jazz fusion band Mezzoforte performed for over an hour at the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague.

programme.title: Mont Saint-Michel: Steve Grossman And Peter King
programme.desc: Every year, the Jazz en Baie festival takes place in the beautiful bay of Mont Saint-Michel. Today’s broadcast shows a special gathering between saxophone heavyweights Peter King and Steve Grossman. These experienced musicians’ trip to the bay amounts to much more than a social call. The quintet, which is rounded out by bass player Duylinh N'Guyen, drummer Stéphane Huchard and pianist Alain Jean-Marie, delivers an amazing show.

programme.title: Ray Charles and the Raelettes - North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by.

programme.title: George Shearing Duo feat. Neil Swainson
programme.desc: British pianist George Shearing enjoyed an international reputation as an instrumentalist, arranger, and composer. Equally at home on the classical concert stage as in jazz clubs, he was recognized for his inventive, orchestrated jazz. In this live recording from the Munich Philharmonie, Shearing played in a duo format with Canadian double bassist Neil Swainson.

programme.title: Forró Series
programme.desc: The Da Pá Virada Sessions series presents the best musicians of contemporary Brazilian jazz, and beyond. Filmed and curated in São Paulo by director and presenter Dani Gurgel and producer and engineer Thiago Rabello, each session offers a unique experience by giving a fresh look into Brazil's music scene. The artists for each session are selected in consultation with Stingray DJAZZ's music editor.

programme.title: Jaco Pastorius
programme.desc: The audience at the Montreal Jazz Festival in Canada was in for a treat on July 3, 1982, as a true musical innovator hit the stage: Jaco Pastorius, who transformed the electric bass into a formidable solo instrument. Combining intricate harmonics, fluid melodies, and unparalleled technical skill, Pastorius left a lasting impact on the music world.

programme.title: Tivoli Utrecht: Sven Hammond Soul
programme.desc: Although its music might sound like the sound track of any 1970s American car chase movie, the band Sven Hammond Soul is from the Netherlands. This steaming soul machine is headed by Sven Figee, who prefers to attack rather than play his Hammond organ. In April 2012, the band was augmented with vocalist Jenny Lane. Today’s recordings were made at a steaming live performance at Utrecht’s Tivoli in 2012.

programme.title: Jazz à Ramatuelle: Parisien meets Kühn And Portal
programme.desc: Since his first appearance at Jazz in Ramatuelle in 2010, saxophonist Émile Parisien has made his mark among the most talented musicians of his generation. On the soprano saxophone, his favorite instrument, he invented a unique lyrical style.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Episode 5: Chet Baker - Jazz Greats
programme.desc: American trumpet player and occasional singer Chet Baker (1929-1988) was one of the most popular exponents of bebop and cool jazz. At the age of 10, Baker was introduced to music in a school orchestra, after which he discovered bebop in the army in 1946. After serving six months in prison in 1953 for drug possession, Baker formed his own quartet with West Coast jazz great, pianist Russ Freeman.

programme.title: Betty Carter/Jazzmeia Horn, Please Do Something
programme.desc: Vocalist Jazzmeia Horn’s 2019 Malta Jazz Festival appearance was a celebration of jazz’s future, infused with the soul of its past. Featuring Keith Brown (piano), Rashaan Carter (bass), Irwin Hall (flute and saxophone), and Anwar Marshall (drums), the young singer’s performance was a reminder of jazz’s enduring power to speak to the heart.

programme.title: Anita Oday Live in Sweden 1963
programme.desc: Anita O’Day?boasts two wonderful concerts from 1963 and 1970 that present the “jazz singer supreme” in impeccable form. O’Day’s horn-based approach to singing is in full effect throughout both shows including stand-out renditions in each show of audience favorites “Tea For Two” and “Sweet Georgia Brown” (both reprised from her triumphant appearance at the 1958 Newport Jazz Festival.

programme.title: Live at the Office: BIGYUKI And Now vs Now
programme.desc: Rotterdam’s ‘ BIRD’ is a club, café and restaurant with a live music programme that's deeply rooted in jazz, and also branches out towards soul, funk, hip-hop and electronic music as well. Its name ‘BIRD’ refers to the nickname of the legendary New York jazz saxophonist, bebop co-founder Charlie Parker (1920-1955). BIRD serves Neapolitan pizzas, good wines, no-nonsense beers and an all-round metropolitan rawness.

programme.title: Medley
programme.desc: Brazilian artist Gilberto Gil returns to Jazz à Vienne in France with a new round of singing that is inspired by his latest album ‘Fé na Festa’: a mixture of celebration, tradition and even some rock now and then. Gilberto Gil, worldwide known for as musician and the Brazilian minister of Culture, was one of the pioneers of the cultural movement ‘tropicalismo’.

programme.title: Episode 3: Miles Davis - Jazz Greats
programme.desc: American trumpeter Miles Davis (1926-1991) was a pioneering jazz musician from the late 1940s to the late 1980s. His influence on 20th century music is hard to overstate, as he trailblazed bebop, cool jazz, hardbop, modal jazz, and electronic music. On October 11, 1964, Miles Davis performed at Teatro Dell’Arte in Milan.

programme.title: VEIN Plays Ravel
programme.desc: A sound support with provocative combinations, a modern music laboratory, a vehicle of inspiration whose importance has been proven by many high-profile collaborations. Music lovers who appreciate jazz for its ability to provoke and continuously question the status quo certainly do not expect that such a standard set in its configuration finds itself completely detached from tradition.

programme.title: McCoy Tyner Solo
programme.desc: Pianist McCoy Tyner’s artistry and innovation embrace a multitude of styles, from African and Latin rhythms to the modal harmonies of the post-bebop era. His amazing versatility has enabled him to excel in a wide variety of settings.

programme.title: Bobby McFerrin - Estival Jazz Lugano
programme.desc: Estival Jazz Lugano is an annual, open-air music festival that takes place over five days in the picturesque city of Lugano, Switzerland. Since 1979, this musical Mecca has been a must-attend event for all jazz and world music fans worldwide. In 1985, American vocal virtuoso Bobby McFerrin took the stage solo at Estival Jazz Lugano.

programme.title: Travellin’ Blues: Big Daddy Wilson
programme.desc: ‘Jazz en Baie’, a whining guitar sound, and the baritone voice of Big Daddy Wilson are the perfect recipe for an emotional and melancholy blues concert. As a young man, Big Daddy Wilson never saw a real blues concert before he walked into a Bremen club as a young soldier. This revelation drove the expatriate to throw himself head over heals into music.

programme.title: Jazz Batá 2
programme.desc: Legendary Cuban pianist Chucho Valdés brought his band ‘Jazz Batá 2’ to the Malta Jazz Festival on July 19, 2019. The air was thick with anticipation as Valdés took to the stage, revisiting the small-group concept of his mythical 1972 Cuban album ‘Jazz Bata´’. The bata´ repertoire – the deep classical music of West Africa – permeates Valde´s’ piano solos throughout the concert.

programme.title: Sun Ra Arkestra - Estival Jazz Lugano
programme.desc: Estival Jazz Lugano is an annual open-air music festival that takes place over five days at the picturesque city of Lugano, Switzerland. Since 1979, this musical Mecca has been a must-attend event for all jazz and world music fans worldwide. On July 3, 1985, pianist and space-faring jazz icon Sun Ra and his Arkestra crash-landed at Estival Jazz Lugano.

programme.title: Makoto Ozone - Münchner Klaviersommer
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. The concerts were usually held in July at The Gasteig, home of the Munich Philharmonic. In 1984, Japanese jazz pianist Makoto Ozone was one of the artists appearing here.

programme.title: Jazz à Ramatuelle: Antonio Faraò 4tet
programme.desc: Antonio Faraò features prominently in the rich group of talented Italian pianists. He is the winner of the 1998 prestigious Concours Martial Solal, awarded by Herbie Hancock, and he has made his mark as a player of elegance and lyricism. This has allowed him to collaborate with the best European and American musicians. In his album ‘Evan’, recorded in the USA, he leads an all-star band, notably starring Joe Lovano on tenor.

programme.title: Michelle David - Jazz in Duketown
programme.desc: Jazz in Duketown is the largest free outdoor jazz festival in the Netherlands. It's a real gathering for jazz addicts, inviting internationally renowned artists. The talented American singer Michelle David performs pop and gospel music that feeds the heart and soothes the soul. Having grown up with the church, she started singing at the age of four. A year later she joined her first band, The Mission of Love.

programme.title: BIRDtv: Orlando Julius
programme.desc: Rotterdam’s ‘ BIRD’ is a club, café and restaurant with a live music programme that's deeply rooted in jazz, and also branches out towards soul, funk, hip-hop and electronic music as well. Its name ‘BIRD’ refers to the nickname of the legendary New York jazz saxophonist, bebop co-founder Charlie Parker (1920-1955). BIRD serves Neapolitan pizzas, good wines, no-nonsense beers and an all-round metropolitan rawness.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Al di Meola - Münchner Klaviersommer
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. The concerts were usually held in July at The Gasteig, home of the Munich Philharmonic. In 1993, American guitarist Al Di Meola was one of the artists appearing here.

programme.title: Burton Greene - OTO Part I
programme.desc: Legendary free jazz pianist Burton Greene rose to fame in New York City's free jazz scene of the 1960s. Exploring various spontaneous improvisational styles, Greene performs live at Cafe OTO in London, UK.

programme.title: Freddie Hubbard And The Satchmo Legacy Live in 1987
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence. This concert of Freddie Hubbard and the Satchmo Legacy in 1987, highlights the bebop legend's classic style and silky tone.

programme.title: Christian McBride - John Day
programme.desc: On July 20, 2018, double bassist Christian McBride presented his band ‘New Jawn’ at the Malta Jazz Festival. A five-time Grammy winner, McBride is one of the most requested, most recorded, and most respected figures in the music world today. Hailing from Philadelphia, this music luminary combines jazz, RAndB, pop/rock, hip hop/neo-soul, and classical.

programme.title: Blicher Hemmer Gadd - A Music documentary
programme.desc: Award-winning saxophonist Michael Blicher, Hammond wizard Dan Hemmer and legendary drummer Steve Gadd joined forces in 2014 to celebrate their shared love for Hammond-organ soul jazz. The band, which tours extensively throughout the world, has released several albums. Their third album, which was released in November 2019, features U.K. vocalist Paul Carrack on the soulful ballad 'The First One To Know'.

programme.title: Rhoda Scott And La Velle: Hammond, Soul and Blues
programme.desc: American soul and jazz organist Rhoda Scott spent most of her career in France, where she earned recognition far greater than that accorded to her in the United States. There was never any doubt about what instrument she would play as a child. 'It's really the most beautiful instrument in the world,” she once stated in an interview. “The first thing I did was take my shoes off and work the pedals.

programme.title: Dee Dee Bridgewater: Motherland
programme.desc: Singer Dee Dee Bridgewater walks in with considerable credentials, but this documentary related to her album ‘Red Earth’ trumps them all: Red Earth is a Malian journey that merges and melts all borders. While world-beat listeners will recognize the grooves, this is Bridgewater's first time bringing her own experiences as an African-American woman back to the motherland. It results in a fusion of feeling, visions, and music.

programme.title: 'Long Tall Dexter' Live in '64
programme.desc: Dexter Gordon: Live in '63 And '64?features three concerts filmed in Holland, Switzerland, and Belgium that highlight the bebop legend's classic style and silky tone. These shows feature legendary side musicians such as Art Taylor (drums) and Kenny Drew (piano), and jazz classics “Blues Walk”, “A Night In Tunisia”, “Body And Soul”, and others.

programme.title: Wynton Marsalis: In This House, on This Morning
programme.desc: The final concert of the Münchner Klaviersommer 1992 was by Wynton Marsalis and his septet. The 31-years-young star trumpeter performed one of his own jazz suites to the sold-out Philharmonie, under the title of ‘In This House, On This Morning’. The concert covers every jazz style, in composition and improvisation, and in both small and grand forms.

programme.desc: Josué enterra Ezequiel. Otília vai à fazenda de Elói. Miguel Ignácio conta a Josué quem matou seu pai e ele planeja se vingar.

programme.title: Diogo Na Cozinha - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Diogo Nogueira leva para sua casa músicas, receitas, convidados e histórias que fazem qualquer um se sentir parte de um almoço entre amigos.

programme.title: Alma Gêmea - Ep. 128
programme.desc: Guto foge com as joias e arma um plano. Xavier sequestra Terê. Generosa entrega um colar para Alaor. Eduardo faz uma descoberta. Guto e Serena ficam cara a cara.

programme.title: Pantanal - Ep. 50
programme.desc: José Lucas se reconhece nas histórias que Túlio conta sobre a família de José Leôncio. Gustavo se desespera com a morte de Madeleine. Jove conta a Irma que ama Juma, mas confessa que seu lugar não é limitado à vida na tapera. José Leôncio sonha com Madeleine pedindo ajuda para ir embora. Mariana avisa a Jove que ele terá que arrumar um emprego.

programme.title: Império - Ep. 176
programme.desc: Comendador confronta Merival. Xana ajuda Cláudio e Enrico. Marta busca um ombro amigo. Maria Clara investiga o passado de Silviano. Ismael dá ultimato para Lorraine.

programme.title: Passione - Ep. 164
programme.desc: Berilo convence Agostina a voltar com ele. Jéssica comenta com Clô que virou amante de um homem casado. Clara responde às ofensas de Gemma. Candê incentiva a filha a ficar com Gerson. Totó e Clara vão buscar Kelly no abrigo. Alfredo abraça Kelly ao vê-la na pensão de Valentina. Dino convence Totó a deixar Berilo ficar na casa de Gemma. Laura e Cris convencem Mauro e Diana a viajar. Myrna tira uma cópia do passaporte de Fred.

programme.title: A Nobreza do Amor - Ep. 107
programme.desc: Virgínia ouve uma conversa entre Belmira e Diógenes, e acaba descobrindo que Ritinha é sua irmã. Virgínia ameaça Diógenes para deixar seu trabalho na igreja e dar uma promoção a Mirinho. Belmira avisa a Viriato que Virgínia não irá mais ajudá-lo. Embriagado, Mirinho garante a Manoel que não deixará Tonho brilhar na festa da moagem, e Sebastião ouve. Mirinho confronta Tonho.

programme.title: Orgulho e Paixão - Ep. 117
programme.desc: Lídia comenta com Cecília e Mariana sobre a proposta de casamento que recebeu de Randolfo. A mando de Susana, Petúlia seduz Kléber para conseguir as provas contra Elisabeta. Julieta investiga Lady Margareth com Tião. Aurélio pede Julieta em casamento. Petúlia consegue as fotos que incriminam Kléber no incêndio da fábrica, e Susana se anima para chantagear Lady Margareth.

programme.title: Por Você - Ep. 26
programme.desc: Vanessa se revolta contra Gabriel e Bela. Junqueira faz uma proposta de trabalho a Gabriel, e Leandra, Ricardo e Pérola comemoram. Vanessa repreende Junqueira por se adiantar na proposta a Gabriel. Bela alerta Gabriel sobre as consequências de suas ações envolvendo Vanessa. Giovana entrega a Vanessa as informações pedidas sobre os filhos de Juli. Vanessa se aproxima de Peixe.

programme.title: A Gata Comeu - Ep. 32
programme.desc: Alice arma um escândalo no casamento de Fábio. Paula fica desolada. Horácio oferece a Vitório uma mansão. Em um episódio de sonambulismo, Jô arruma mais confusão para Fábio.

programme.title: A Próxima Vítima - Ep. 95
programme.desc: Marcelo discute com Ana e descobre quem não é seu filho. Pressionada, Ana conta a verdade. Irene segue no hospital. Marcelo revela um segredo à Isabela.

programme.title: Malhação: Seu Lugar no Mundo T22 - Ep. 57
programme.desc: Ciça sugere que Rodrigo seja o produtor da banda. Filipe pede emprego a Uodson no hostel. Nanda começa a trabalhar na loja de roupa infantil. Pedro aceita que Rodrigo seja produtor da banda. Roger conversa com Alina e Luciana sobre Lívia. Julia pede ajuda de Artur para vender rifa para a viagem da turma. Ana aconselha Lívia a ser honesta com Roger. Ciça pensa em demitir Vilma por ciúmes de Uodson.

programme.title: Jornal Da Globo
programme.desc: Traz um olhar mais analítico sobre os principais assuntos do dia. Conta com a colaboração de colunistas em áreas como economia e cultura.

programme.title: A Gata Comeu - Ep. 33
programme.desc: Ofélia arma um escândalo ao ver Jô na cama de Fábio. Convicta de que Jô quer atrapalhar seu casamento, Paula toma uma decisão. Estrategicamente, Jô leva Adriana para tomar sorvete.

programme.title: A Nobreza do Amor - Ep. 108
programme.desc: Embriagado, Mirinho confronta Tonho, que o leva para casa. Mirinho afirma a sua família que ama Lúcia/Alika, e Casemiro tenta se desculpar com Tonho. Alika se surpreende ao saber que Tonho decidiu comprar terras para os dois. Omar chega a Recife. As famílias de Salma e Fuad celebram seu noivado oficial, apesar do desconforto da moça. Sebastião conta a Virgínia sobre a embriaguez de Mirinho.

programme.title: A Próxima Vítima - Ep. 96
programme.desc: Helena vai à polícia e conta ao investigador Olavo todos os acontecimentos. Filomena desconfia de Adalberto. Eliseo revela para Adalberto o que Isabela contou para Filomena.

programme.title: Alma Gêmea - Ep. 129
programme.desc: Guto se surpreende com o perdão de Serena. Eduardo mente para Rafael. Cristina finge sofrer pela perda do bebê. Guto desabafa com Alexandra e toma uma decisão.

programme.title: Orgulho e Paixão - Ep. 118
programme.desc: legário sequestra Susana. Camilo explica a Darcy sua ideia de fazer um café especial, e os dois firmam uma sociedade. Tião se oferece para trabalhar para Lady Margareth. Petúlia e Lady Margareth constatam o desaparecimento de Susana. Otávio e Luccino se aproximam. Susana se desespera ao acordar ao lado de Olegário. Ludmila anuncia a François e Ema que ambos tocarão a loja de agora em diante.

programme.title: Por Você - Ep. 27
programme.desc: Bela encontra Samuca com Vanessa na praia, e desconfia de que a rival tenha provocado a situação intencionalmente. Gabriel desiste do trabalho com Junqueira após descobrir que foi armação de Vanessa. Enzo empurra Margô, que se sente humilhada. Junqueira convida Vanessa para jantar. Pérola descobre os planos escusos de Vanessa para sua sucessão no hospital.

programme.title: Pantanal - Ep. 51
programme.desc: Tibério fica sabendo que Levi procurou Muda. Tenório não gosta de saber que Maria Bruaca saiu para cavalgar com Alcides. José Leôncio fica feliz com a chegada de Jove e Irma. José Lucas diz a Túlio que será peão. Jove volta para a tapera de Juma. Tenório não acredita que possa perder Maria Bruaca. Gustavo resolve dar um tempo do consultório e convida Nayara para viajar com ele sem destino.

programme.title: Império - Ep. 177
programme.desc: Maurílio faz uma proposta para o Comendador. Cláudio luta pela vida e Enrico é o único que pode ajudá-lo. Cora se aproxima de Téo Pereira. José Pedro recebe uma má notícia.

programme.title: Passione - Ep. 165
programme.desc: Mauro tenta impedir Diana de ir embora. Jéssica se esconde no armário da quitinete quando Agostina entra. Olavo ameaça dormir longe de Clô enquanto ela não aceitar o seu trabalho. Fred intimida Myrna. Sinval segue Stela até o encontro com Agnello. Kelly emociona Clara e a família de Totó durante o jantar. Bete se incomoda ao descobrir que Totó voltou com Clara. Olga fica furiosa ao perceber que Diogo se apaixonou por Clara.

José Lucas diz a Túlio que será peão. Jove volta para a tapera de Juma. Tenório não acredita que possa perder Maria Bruaca. Maria Helena confessa a Dôra o motivo de ter se casado com Fortunato. Com receio das ameaças de Virgínia, Diógenes inventa uma desculpa para promover Mirinho no banco.
